name: Pragma BioSync Underlayer Mark II
description: A second-skin compression shirt and legging set in deep slate blue with subtle silver biometric-trace lines running along major vascular pathways — decorative only from the outside, but each line conceals a sensor filament. The Mark II reads heart rate, blood oxygenation, cortisol levels, hydration, and skin galvanic response, feeding data continuously to a paired BCI or wristmount. Fabric is smooth matte elastane-synthetic with just enough compression to feel intentional without being medical. Common among Tier 3 desk workers trying to optimize.
functionality: Continuous passive biometric monitoring synced to BCI or companion app; alerts for stress spikes, dehydration, and cardiac irregularities. Light compression aids circulation during sedentary work. Port loop at the nape routes data without external cabling.
what_it_says: You're optimizing yourself the way you optimize a spreadsheet — methodically, slightly anxiously.
manufacturer: Pragma Systems — Tier 3 wellness corponation label
story_hooks: The Mark II's data feed is stored server-side by Pragma — a leaked document suggests that data is being sold to insurance underwriters.
A wearer's cortisol log shows they were in extreme distress at the exact time they claim they were home asleep.
Someone has been spoofing healthy biometric readings through a hardware mod — and they're about to walk into a mandatory corporate wellness screening.
related_entities: NeuralPath CivID Plus Identity & Payment BCI

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, form-fitting second-skin set that clings to the torso and legs with athletic intention. The deep slate blue reads almost black under poor lighting, broken only by fine silver tracery that maps the human circulatory system—delicate, purposeful, and subtly augmented-looking without screaming implant. The silhouette is clean and modern, broadcasting both wellness optimization and corporate compliance.
physical_description.fit: Compression-tailored but not restrictive; designed to be worn as a base layer under work clothes or visible as athletic wear. Hugs the body like a second skin without the medical-grade tightness that signals actual injury recovery. Allows full range of motion while maintaining subtle tension across major muscle groups.
physical_description.primary_material: Matte elastane-synthetic blend—smooth to the touch, moisture-wicking, engineered for thermal regulation and durability through daily wear and frequent washing.
physical_description.texture: Ultra-smooth, almost liquid-feeling matte finish with zero sheen. Microscopic ribbed structure visible only at close inspection; the silver sensor filaments add the only tactile variation, running raised but not uncomfortably so.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep slate blue base—corporate-neutral, professional, slightly cold in tone. Silver biometric trace lines form anatomical branching patterns down the arms, across the chest, and along the legs. No logos or branding visible on the garment itself.
physical_description.closures: None. The shirt pulls on overhead; the leggings feature a high, fitted waistband with internal friction-grip elastic. Designed for seamless integration with daily clothing.
distinctive_features: Silver sensor filaments mapped along major vascular pathways—purely decorative externally but concealing functional bioelectric tracery
Integrated heart rate, blood oxygen, cortisol, hydration, and galvanic response sensors woven into fabric matrix
Continuous wireless data feed to paired BCI neural interface or wristmount display
Seamless construction with no visible seams or tags
Reinforced panels at high-stress areas (shoulders, inner thighs, lower back)
Subtle Pragma Systems monogram woven at the collarbone—visible only when inspected closely
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3 corporate wellness standard—accessible to working-class professionals but carrying undertones of self-optimization culture. Not luxury, but aspirational and tech-forward.
physical_description.cultural_context: Signals a desk worker or service professional who buys into corporate wellness metrics, biohacking culture, and continuous self-monitoring. Worn by people who track everything, trust their data streams, and view the body as a system to be optimized. Common in GLMZ corpo offices and wellness-conscious Tier 3 communities.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine to well-maintained. Regular wear shows no degradation; faded slightly at creases from frequent washing. Sensor filaments remain clearly visible and functional. The garment is designed for longevity and maintains its visual sharpness through dozens of wash cycles.
